title: He Insulted My Mom's Cooking… Then SHE Walked In 🤖 Ep.1

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lunch break. Room twelve. And Bruno was about to make the biggest mistake of his entire school year.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Ohhhhh, here we go again. Open the lid, curry boy. Let the whole class enjoy the smell.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's my mom's kacchi biryani, Bruno. She wakes up at five in the morning to make it. For me.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Five a.m.? For THIS? Bro, she should've slept in… and ordered a pizza.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Yo… did he just disrespect your MOM? Right here?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Joy. Don't. He's not worth it. Just… eat your rice.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Awww, listen to him. Protecting mommy's little recipe. Walk. Away. Curry. Boy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now here's the thing about our school. The hallway behind room twelve… has one blind spot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And in that blind spot… stood Principal Huda.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: P—Principal Huda! Ma'am! I— that was— we were just joking around!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Joking. About a mother. Who cooks at five in the morning. In MY hallway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The temperature in that room dropped ten degrees. Even the ceiling fan slowed down.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Quiet, Nix. Bruno. Tomorrow. Lunch break. My office. Bring your appetite.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: My… appetite? Ma'am, what does that—

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Oh, Bruno knew exactly what it meant. And the whole school was about to find out.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for part two. Because what she did to him… became school legend.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Trust me. You were NOT ready for this punishment.
